That is the Chinese title for "The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild". We should pass that as the game_name. For platform, we can either leave it out or set it to "all platforms". The function signature says platform has default "all platforms", so we can omit it. But the function expects an object with keys game_name and platform. If we omit platform, maybe it's okay because it has default. But to be safe, we can include platform: "all platforms".
